sicily_loc.title: Beachhead--Operating at top speed and with machine-like precision, first U.S. troops ashore near Scoglitti, Sicily, set up anti-aircraft guns, deploy out to fend off Axis counter-attacks. These men debarked from the same type of landing barge as the one landing another squad of invaders in the background
